name: Solomon ibn Gabirol (Avicebron)
shortBio: Sephardic Jewish Neoplatonist poet and philosopher of Málaga and Valencia; formulated Universal Hylomorphism (spiritual matter and form in all created beings) in The Fountain of Life.
centralQuestion: Do all created spiritual and corporeal entities share a universal underlying matter shaped by divine will?

keyWorks.title: The Fountain of Life (Fons Vitae / Yanbu' al-Hayat)
keyWorks.description: Groundbreaking Neoplatonic dialogue developing universal hylomorphism, influencing Duns Scotus, Bonaventure, and medieval metaphysics.

keyWorks.title: The Crown of Kingdom (Keter Malkhut)
keyWorks.description: Masterwork poem synthesizing Ptolemaic cosmology, philosophical astronomy, and divine unity.
